name: Minor Medical Miracle
body:
Prerequisite: Wis 13, First Aid, Heal 7 ranks

Benefit: You can save a character reduced to their negative hit points or lower, when they would normally be dead. If you are able to administer aid within 3 rounds of the character’s death, you can make a Heal check. The DC for this check is 30, and you can’t take 10 or take 20. If the check succeeds, the dead character can make a Fortitude save (DC 15) to stabilize and be restored to 0 hit points.
